newsitem.title: SWEDEN: NCC says to sell/list NK Cityfastigheter.
newsitem.headline: NCC says to sell/list NK Cityfastigheter.

text.p: Sweden's second largest construction company NCC said on Thursday that it was to sell off and list property unit NK Cityfastigheter AB that has a book value of about 2.2 billion crowns.
"The real estate portfolio will consist of the NK buildings in Stockholm and Gothenburg as well as centrally located galleria buildings in four other cities in Sweden," NCC said in a statement.
NCC said the book value of the properties would be nearly 2.2 billion crowns. It would continue to hold a major interest in the company.
It gave no other details of the deal.
NK is a Swedish department store.
